sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.title: DDL
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.body.desc: Controls whether the DDL includes the type body or package body
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.constrain: Controls whether the DDL includes non-referential constraints
Controls whether the DDL includes table constraints as separate `ALTER TABLE` and if necessary `CREATE INDEX` statements
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.emit_sche: Controls whether the DDL includes the schema information
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.force.des: Controls whether use the `FORCE` keyword in the `CREATE VIEW` statement
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.insert.de: Controls whether include the `INSERT` statements into the `OL$` dictionary tables that will create the outline and its hints
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.oid.descr: Controls whether the DDL includes the OID (Object Identifier)
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.partition: Controls whether the DDL includes the partitioning clauses
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.pretty.de: Controls whether the DDL is formatted for better readability
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.ref_const: Controls whether the DDL includes the referential constraints (foreign keys)
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.segment_a: Controls whether the DDL includes the segment attributes (physical attributes, storage attributes, tablespace, logging)
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.size_byte: Controls whether the DDL includes the `BYTE` keyword as part of the size specification of `CHAR` and `VARCHAR2` columns that use byte semantics
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.specifica: Controls whether the DDL includes the type or package specification
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.sqltermin: Controls whether the DDL includes the SQL terminator (`;` or `/`)
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.storage.d: Controls whether the DDL includes the storage clauses
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.tablespac: Controls whether the DDL includes the tablespace clauses
sqldeveloper.configuration.ddl.collation: Controls whether the DDL includes the collation clauses or sorting order for character data
Collation clauses other than `USING_NLS_COMP` are generated
sqldeveloper.configuration.sqlHistory.li: Maximum number of SQL History records
sqldeveloper.configuration.notifications: Controls the duration in seconds of dismissible information notifications
sqldeveloper.configuration.plsqlCompiler: This option should be used when attempting to delete/replace an object type that has dependencies. If this option is not checked, object types with dependencies cannot be deleted/replaced
sqldeveloper.configuration.worksheet.exp: Controls the level of the details displayed in an explain plan
Displays maximum information about the explain plan
Displays minimum information about the explain plan
Similar to TYPICAL except that the parallel execution information is not displayed
Displays the most relevant information in the explain plan

sqldeveloper.logging.level.trace:
Log very detailed messages that help developers diagnose the root cause of an issue.

May contain sensitive data
